honest_scope: Per-run disposition of `trusted-engine-build` artifacts. A build being deterministic and source-consistent is not the same as a build being releasable; this file records the second judgement, which is the one an operator makes. Entries are append-only: a rejected build stays rejected in the record even after a corrected one supersedes it, because the reason it was rejected is the thing future readers need.

dispositions.reason: The artifact's own engine-identity.json recorded state=PROTECTED_ENGINE_IDENTITY and a provenance honest_scope asserting that the producing workflow 'runs only on a protected ref'. GitHub reported main protected=false, and the workflow had only asserted that the ref was refs/heads/main. The state was a module-level constant, so no input could have produced a different claim and there was no state of the world in which the record would have been accurate. A truthful note added later to governance/midterm-panel-engine-release.json cannot repair a false claim the artifact makes about itself, so this artifact must not be the one named in the live release configuration.
dispositions.retained: The artifact may be kept for comparison against the corrected build. It is not approved for production use and no provider-backed run may load it.
